title: Changi Airport Terminal 5 Sustainability and Climate Change Mitigation Measures
what_it_is: Changi Airport Terminal 5 Sustainability and Climate Change Mitigation Measures

sections.label: Changi Airport climate change measures
sections.summary: The Report describes measures taken to protect Changi Airport, including drainage enhancement, tidal gates and raising Changi East platform level, with continued monitoring for T5.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Report describes measures that have been taken including the enhancement of the drainage network at Changi Airport, installation of tidal gates and raising the platform level at Changi East to 5.5 metres above mean sea level.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: I have also given a Written reply to Dr Tan Wu Meng's Parliamentary Question on 13 September 2022 on the mitigating measures that have been taken to protect Changi Airport against the effect of higher temperatures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor technological developments and review and enhance the measures for T5 to be green, sustainable and resilient to climate change.
